hero.name: Ali Mansouri
hero.title: Solutions Architect
hero.manifesto: I diagnose messy enterprise operations, map the system dynamics, frame the architecture, and ship the digital infrastructure that sustains growth.

aboutMe.title: Summary
aboutMe.text: Hands-on Solutions Architect with 5+ years delivering cloud-native platforms, enterprise automation, and AI/LLM systems end-to-end, from requirements framing and scalability design to reliability strategy and deployment. I treat organizational friction as structural technical debt: I diagnose the real problem before solutioning, then build the core services where execution depth matters most. My stack spans Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, Python, n8n, and LLM systems (RAG, agents, LangChain), grounded by a Ph.D. candidacy in Futures Studies and an MBA in HR. At Snapp!, Iran's largest super-app, I architected a multi-module internal platform for 1,000+ users and delivered LMS and HR digital infrastructure across 3+ business units.

pillars.title: Strategic Foresight
pillars.text: Ph.D.-level system dynamics and scenario modelling to architect for where the organization is moving, not where it is today.

pillars.title: Cloud-Native Engineering
pillars.text: Production Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform and CI/CD blueprints built for resilience, governance, and reproducible delivery.

pillars.title: AI & Automation
pillars.text: Pragmatic, live LLM architecture (RAG, vector databases, LangChain) embedded into workflows, not standalone chat experiments.

positions.title: Solutions Architect (Cloud, Systems & AI)
points: Architected and governed cloud-native infrastructure for internal services on Docker and production Kubernetes (Helm), owning scalability, system resilience, and deployment strategy.
Engineered a multi-module enterprise automation platform (LDAP/OIDC SSO, RBAC, governance dashboards, module-level permissions) serving 1,000+ internal users; authored the core Python/SQL services.
Released 10+ production services through a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline (build, test, deploy), cutting manual deployment effort and release risk.
Built LLM-powered automation into live operations using RAG, a vector database, and LangChain, cutting document-triage time by 50%+ (15+ hours/week saved).
Drove end-to-end delivery of LMS and HR digital infrastructure across 3+ business units, from stakeholder discovery and requirements framing through architecture and deployment.

positions.title: Solutions Architect (Workflow, Systems & Integrations)

Specified the integration architecture across Jira, GitLab, Confluence, SQL Server, and Recruitee; deployed n8n as a resilient workflow mesh unifying 6+ backend services and APIs.
Scoped platform extensions (helpdesk, process designer, data connectors, creative automation) from fit-gap analysis, reducing ad-hoc IT tickets by 35%.
